Context: `frame`, `groups`, `ignored`, `suggested`, `checked`. -#} {% from "components/page_card.html" import page_card %} {% from "components/format.html" import caller_text, num, bytes %} {% from "components/badges.html" import badge, status_badge %} {% from "components/icon.html" import icon %} {% from "components/empty.html" import empty_state %} {% from "components/glossary.html" import term with context %} {% set actions %}{% endset %} {% call page_card(frame, actions=actions, subtitle="Checked " ~ checked) %} Key spread

A caller that adds a changing value to every request (a timestamp, a random number) makes each request a different question. Answers pile up, and the hit count never moves, because no two requests ever ask the same thing. This is the {{ term("key-spread", "key spread") }}: the one cache failure that looks like success on every other number.

Each row is one endpoint path. Many stored answers behind one path with no reuse is the giveaway, and the parameter doing it is named: Ignore leaves it out of the cache key so those requests collapse back into one.
